mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) and declining consumer spending (RSAFS growth < 0.5% monthly) indicates a weakening labor market and reduced consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5% and RSAFS growth < 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high housing market activity (HOUST > 650k units monthly), consumer confidence and spending increase, leading to stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 650.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates a weak supply environment under accommodative monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 95 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of robust industrial production (INDPRO > 100), manufacturing output expands, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100.
